bio.text: Bob Godfrey, a Democrat, has represented Connecticut House District 110 since 1989.

According to Ballotpedia, his professional experience includes working as an attorney with the Connecticut Bank and Trust Company, law clerk of the Danbury Probate Court, vice president of public affairs for the Greater Danbury Chamber of Commerce, and committee clerk with the Connecticut General Assembly.
Ballotpedia also lists service as a radioman in the U.S. Naval Reserves.
